stories.description: POV: You found the edge of the enchanted map. Exploring the hidden realms of the Aetherial Wilds. 🌿✨ #fantasy #worldbuilding #magic

scenes.visual_prompt: An extreme close-up of a glowing, iridescent dragon scale pulsing with teal light. sudden fast camera push-in (zoom shock) into the microscopic textures of the scale, revealing a shimmering galaxy within. Then motion stabilizes into a slow, liquid-like shimmer. Cinematic macro, floating magical embers, ultra-detailed, 720p.
scenes.visual_reference: HOOK: Use the iridescent textures and 'zoom shock' to grab attention. The 'shimmering galaxy' inside the scale adds a high-fantasy surreal touch.

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide cinematic shot of a floating island suspended by massive glowing violet vines over a sea of clouds. Huge waterfalls flow upward into the sky. Camera: slow steady dolly move through the clouds toward the island, realistic depth, ethereal lighting, dreamlike atmosphere, 720p.
scenes.visual_reference: Context: Show the 'scale' of the fantasy world. The upward-flowing water creates that 'gravity-defying' fantasy aesthetic Gen-Z loves.

scenes.visual_prompt: A cinematic shot of an ancient, stone-carved gateway in a dark forest. As the camera approaches, the air inside the archway begins to ripple like water, revealing a hyper-vibrant neon jungle on the other side. Camera: slow controlled movement toward the portal, sharp focus on the ripple effect, cinematic contrast, 720p.
scenes.visual_reference: Example: A 'portal' shot is a classic high-engagement visual. The contrast between the dark forest and neon jungle is a visual 'pop'.

scenes.visual_prompt: A silhouette of a person standing at the edge of a cliff, looking at a twin-sun sunset over a crystalline city. Their cloak flows in the wind, and they slowly raise a hand as golden runes begin to circle their wrist. Camera: slow gentle pull-back, epic scale, cinematic lighting, realistic cloth physics, 720p.
scenes.visual_reference: Final Reveal: The 'Main Character' shot. The glowing runes provide a satisfying, magical payoff for the end of the short.
